newsitem.title: Argentina: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Nov 12 - Santa Fe - one vessel loading wheat, no vessels in roads, no vessels due, max. recommended draft 28 ft. 9 in. at access channel. Diamante - no vessels berthed, no vessels in roads, no vessels due, max. draft 30 ft. passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - five vessels berthed of which 1 loading sun pellets, 3 loading SBM, 1 loading SBO, 4 vessels in roads, 20 due at 9 terminals during the coming week, max. recommended draft 34 ft. 4 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep rising for the next week. Pasa berth draft 24 ft. 6 in. fw., Nidera berth draft 34 ft. fw.

Rosario - six vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 1 loading maize, 1 loading SBMP, 1 loading sugar, 1 loading fertiliser, 1 vessel in roads, 4 vessels due during the coming week, max. recommended draft 34 ft. 4 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep rising for the next week. Villa Constitucion - no vessels berthed, no vessels in roads, 2 vessels due, max. recommended draft 34 ft 4 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep rising for the next week. Elevator berths max. draft 22 ft. fw.

San Nicolas - one vessel discharging general cargo, 2 vessels in roads, 8 vessels due during the coming week, max. recommended draft 34 ft. 4 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep rising for the next week. San Pedro - no vessels in roads, no vessels due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Max. recommended draft for Mitre channel as follows (high tide) - 32 ft. 6 in.

Buenos Aires - 25 vessels in port, 35 vessels due during the coming week, max. recommended draft 31 ft. 6 in. fw. High tide at Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock Sud max. recommended draft 29 ft. fw. High tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel).

Necochea - two vessels berthed of which 1 loading wheat, 1 loading urea, no vessels in roads, 4 vessels due during the coming week, max. draft 40 ft. Bahia Blanca - three vessels berthed of which 1 loading nitrogenous, 1 discharging naphtha, 1 loading naphtha, no vessels in roads, 13 vessels due during the coming week, draft depends on each berth.

PERU, Nov 1 - Callao - one vessel in bay, 10 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - one bulk urea in pier, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Ilo - no vessels in ports. Talara - three vessels in bay, 1 in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Chimbote - two vessels in bay, 1 in pier (fishmeal), no berthing delays. Pisco - one vessel in pier (briquettes), no berthing delays. Port was closed due to heavy swell from 0700 hours 2/11, and reopened 0730 hours 5/11.

VENEZUELA, Nov 11 - Puerto Cabello - four vessels anchored, 12 berthed of which 7 grain, 1 bulk cargo, 1 ro/ro, 3 containers. Guanta - four vessels anchored, 3 general cargo vessels berthed. 12 nov - orinoco river - draft 34 ft. Puerto Ordaz - one vessel loading iron ore, 7 vessels due. Rain. Boca Grande - two vessels due. Rain. Palua - one vessel due. Rain.

Mile 178 - one vessel waiting at anchorage. Rain. Matanzas - four vessels operating of which 3 loading steel products, 1 discharging generals, 7 vessels due. Rain. Venalum - one vessel loading aluminium, 1 vessel due. Rain. San Felix - three vessels due. Punta Cuchillo - two vessels loading crude oil. Puerto Cabello - 15 vessels operating of which 9 loading/discharging generals, 6 discharging grain, 20 vessels due.

Guanta - three vessels operating of which 1 discharging explosives, 1 discharging wheat, 1 loading scrap, 5 vessels due. La Guaira - no information available. Maracaibo - one vessel waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 3 vessels loading/discharging generals.

Bajo Grande - three vessels due. Puerto Miranda - five vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - two vessels loading urea, 1 vessel due. La Salina - one vessel loading crude oil. Buoy B71 - two vessels loading coal. La Ceiba - one vessel due.

Punta Palma, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, Palmarejo Sur, San Francisco - no vessels in ports. Cardon - no information available. Guaranao - one vessel loading/discharging generals. Amuay - three vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels loading refined products. All ports working normally.
